name: Attack Potion
text: Choose 1 of 3 random Attack cards to add to your hand, it costs 0 this turn.

name: Blessing of the Forge
text: Upgrade all cards in your hand for the rest of combat.

name: Blood Potion
text: Heal for 20% of your Max HP.

name: Colorless Potion
text: Choose 1 of 3 random Colorless cards to add to your hand, it costs 0 this turn.

name: Distilled Chaos
text: Play the top 3 cards of your draw pile.

name: Duplication Potion
text: This turn, your next card is played twice.

name: Elixir
text: Exhaust any number of cards in your hand.

name: Entropic Brew
text: Fill all your empty potion slots with random potions.

name: Essence Of Darkness
text: Channel 1 Dark for each orb slot.

name: Fairy in a Bottle
text: When you would die, heal to 30% of your Max HP instead and discard this potion.

name: Gambler's Brew
text: Discard any number of cards then draw that many.

name: Liquid Memories
text: Choose a card in your discard pile and return it to your hand. It costs 0 this turn.

name: Power Potion
text: Choose 1 of 3 random Power cards to add to your hand, it costs 0 this turn.

name: Skill Potion
text: Choose 1 of 3 random Skill cards to add to your hand, it costs 0 this turn.

name: Smoke Bomb
text: Escape from a non-boss combat. Receive no rewards.

name: Snecko Oil
text: Draw 5 cards. Randomize the cost of cards in your hand.

name: Speed Potion
text: Gain 5 Dexterity. At the end of your turn, lose Dexterity.

name: Flex Potion
text: Gain 5 Strength. At the end of your turn, lose Strength.
